    # fit sigma = c0 + c1*eps^p via grid p
    best=None

import numpy as np
import scipy.optimize as so

def f(p):
    return p[0]*np.exp(p[1]/T)+(p[2]+p[3]*T)*eps**(p[4]+p[5]/T)+p[6]*(1-np.exp(-(p[7]+p[8]*T)*eps))
bestv=9.0; bestx=None
for k in range(150):
    p0=rng.normal(0,1,9)
    r=so.least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-sigma, p0, max_nfev=3000)
    v=float(np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma))
    if np.isfinite(v) and v<bestv:
